Hi Marie —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the W-9. To complete a bank-change in our vendor master we need:
1) Completed Redwood Vendor Change Form (attached). Please have an authorized signer fill & sign.
2) Bank confirmation letter or a copy of a voided check (bank letter preferred for wire changes).
3) Confirmation of the PO number(s) that should be associated with the new account (you mentioned PO R-8452).

Once we receive the signed form and bank letter we'll run a validation with Treasury and update the vendor record. That change is typically effective for new invoices and future payments; we will not re-run payments already issued unless we identify a transaction in-flight.

I'll kick off the validation once the attachments arrive. In the meantime, if your AP wants to expedite, we can do a preliminary hold-lift for PO R-8452 while the documentation is verified — confirm if you'd like that.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
